rows.head: Forsling sparks the Panthers back from three down
rows.story: What a comeback. Sam Reinhart struck first for the Panthers early in the first, but J.T. Compher made it 1-1 for Detroit just 15 seconds later. Andreas Englund scored his first goal for Detroit midway through the period to put the Red Wings ahead 2-1.
rows.calls: Zero of three preview calls held

rows.head: Hofer blanks the Mammoth
rows.story: No goal counted through overtime. Liam O'Brien and Ross Johnston squared off early in the first. St.
rows.calls: One of two preview calls held

rows.head: Schenn has a goal and two assists as the Islanders beat the Kings
rows.story: Tony DeAngelo played his 500th NHL game. Brayden Schenn opened the scoring for the Islanders early in the first, but Trevor Moore made it 1-1 for Los Angeles just over three minutes later. Matthew Schaefer restored the Islanders’ lead on the power play just over four minutes later.
rows.calls: One of three preview calls held

rows.head: Scheifele ties Hawerchuk for the Jets’ points record
rows.story: Arttu Hyry got the scoring started for the Stars early in the first. The Jets’ Dylan DeMelo left in the first period and didn’t return. The next day, he was placed on injured reserve.
rows.calls: One of three preview calls held

rows.head: Hagel has two goals and an assist as the Lightning take down the Blue Jackets
rows.story: Brandon Hagel opened the scoring for the Lightning early in the first. Matthew Knies made it 1-1 for Columbus on the power play midway through the period, but the Blue Jackets didn’t score again. Midway through the first, Mathieu Olivier and Scott Sabourin fought, and Ryan Lomberg and Jeffrey Viel dropped the gloves.

rows.head: Boldy bags a hat trick
rows.story: Matt Boldy got the scoring started for the Wild late in the first. Auston Matthews and Zack MacEwen scored just under three minutes apart early in the second to turn a 1-0 deficit into a 2-1 lead. The Wild’s Joel Eriksson Ek left in the second period and didn’t return.
rows.calls: One of four preview calls held

rows.head: Pinto plays hero in overtime
rows.story: Shane Pinto got the scoring started for the Senators early in the first, and Tim Stützle made it 2-0 midway through the period. The Avalanche’s Nathan MacKinnon left in the second period and didn’t return. The next day, he was listed as day to day with a lower-body injury.

rows.head: The Blackhawks end a six-game winless run
rows.story: The Blackhawks won for the first time in seven games, after going 0-5-1. Owen Power got the scoring started for the Sabres midway through the first, but Frank Nazar tied it up for Chicago on the power play less than four minutes later. Tage Thompson restored the Sabres’ lead on the power play less than four minutes later.
rows.calls: Two of three preview calls held

rows.head: Hellebuyck wins his first six, a Devils record
rows.story: Vladislav Kolyachonok made his Devils debut, after playing for the Bruins. Evan Rodrigues got the scoring started for the Devils on the power play early in the first. Ryan Leonard tied it 1-1 for Washington on the power play midway through the period.
rows.calls: Zero of two preview calls held

rows.head: Hall plays his 1,000th game as the Hurricanes beat the Kraken
rows.story: Nikolaj Ehlers struck first for the Hurricanes midway through the first, and the goal stood after the Kraken challenged for goalie interference. Sebastian Aho made it 2-0 on the power play just over a minute later, and Juuso Välimäki extended the lead to 3-0 midway through the second. Aho scored his second of the night midway through the third to make it 4-0.

rows.head: The Canadiens take down the Bruins
rows.story: Kirby Dach struck first for the Canadiens early in the first, and Josh Anderson made it 2-0 midway through the period. The second period belonged to the Canadiens: Jake Evans scored, Cole Caufield scored, and Phillip Danault scored to make it 5-0. Boston pulled Jeremy Swayman after four goals and turned to Michael DiPietro for the rest of the second.
rows.calls: One of two preview calls held

rows.head: The Predators make it seven straight
rows.story: Ryan O'Reilly got the scoring started for the Predators early in the first, but Victor Olofsson made it 1-1 for Vegas less than four minutes later. Rasmus Andersson put the Golden Knights ahead 2-1 midway through the second. O'Reilly scored his second of the night midway through the third to tie it 2-2.
rows.calls: Zero of two preview calls held

rows.head: Gawdin scores his first two NHL goals as the Rangers beat the Canucks
rows.story: Elias Pettersson (#40) got the scoring started for the Canucks midway through the first, with Brock Boeser picking up his 500th NHL point on the goal. Gabe Perreault made it 1-1 for the Rangers late in the period. The second period belonged to the Rangers.
rows.calls: One of three preview calls held

rows.head: Clash of the titans
rows.story: The Avalanche (11-6-3) lost 4-3 in overtime to Ottawa on Thursday, while the Canadiens (12-3-4) beat Boston 5-2 the same night. Two of the league’s best teams meet. Going in, the Avalanche are third in the Central (tied for 11th in the NHL) and the Habs second in the Atlantic (tied for fifth).

rows.head: A grinder’s delight
rows.story: Both teams have won two in a row. Going in, the Panthers are fifth in the Atlantic (13th in the NHL) and the Blues seventh in the Central (tied for 18th). The Panthers forecheck harder than anyone (1st), hit a lot (1st) and don't block many shots (32nd).

rows.head: Old-time hockey
rows.story: The Islanders won the teams’ first meeting this season, 3-2 on Long Island on Oct 20. The Islanders (8-6-4) beat Los Angeles 5-2 on Thursday, while the Ducks (10-8-1) lost 4-2 to Nashville on Wednesday. Going in, the Isles are fifth in the Metropolitan (tied for 18th in the NHL) and the Ducks third in the Pacific (tied for 16th).

rows.head: A good test for both
rows.story: The Wild won the teams’ first meeting this season, 4-1 in Minnesota on Oct 3. The Bruins (13-5-1) lost 5-2 to Montréal on Thursday, while the Wild have won two in a row. Two good teams meet.

rows.head: The Jets are on a heater
rows.story: The Blackhawks won the teams’ first meeting this season, 4-3 in overtime in Chicago on Oct 15. The Blackhawks (5-13-1) beat Buffalo 3-2 in overtime on Thursday. The Jets have won five straight, the last an 8-3 rout of Dallas, and they’re rolling.

rows.note: Oilers PP vs. Maple Leafs PK
rows.head: The Maple Leafs need a win
rows.story: The Maple Leafs won the teams’ first meeting this season, 7-2 in Edmonton on Oct 24. The Maple Leafs are on a five-game losing streak, while the Oilers have won three straight. Going in, the Oilers are first in the Pacific (third in the NHL) and the Leafs seventh in the Atlantic (tied for 23rd).

rows.head: Somebody has to win
rows.story: The Blue Jackets won the teams’ first meeting this season, 4-3 in overtime in Philadelphia on Oct 27. The Jackets are on a three-game losing streak, and the Flyers (5-10-6) lost 3-2 in overtime to Edmonton on Wednesday. Both teams are near the bottom of the standings.

rows.head: The Red Wings are searching for answers
rows.story: The Lightning won the teams’ first meeting this season, 4-2 in Tampa Bay on Nov 3. The Lightning have won two in a row, while the Red Wings are on a five-game losing streak. This is an Atlantic Division matchup, with the Wings last (tied for 25th in the NHL) and the Lightning first (tied for fifth).

rows.head: The Stars’ edge in the penalty kill
rows.story: The Stars won the teams’ first meeting this season, 4-0 in Buffalo on Oct 8. The Stars (10-6-2) lost 8-3 to Winnipeg on Thursday, and the Sabres are winless in three (0-2-1). Going in, the Sabres are sixth in the Atlantic (tied for 18th in the NHL) and the Stars fourth in the Central (tied for 14th).

rows.head: Tomasino returns to Pittsburgh
rows.story: The Senators (12-6-2) beat Colorado 4-3 in overtime on Thursday, and the Penguins (7-10-2) beat San Jose 3-2 in a shootout on Wednesday. Going in, the Senators are fourth in the Atlantic (tenth in the NHL) and the Penguins sixth in the Metropolitan (tied for 27th). The Senators’ record (.650) is running ahead of what their chances are worth (.573), largely because they’re 6-2 in one-goal games.

rows.head: A long night for Logan Thompson
rows.story: The teams have split two meetings this season. The Devils come in at 14-6-0, the Capitals at 10-7-0. This is a Metropolitan Division matchup, with the Devils second (tied for fifth in the NHL) and the Caps fourth (tied for 18th).

rows.head: Open season on the Kraken’s net
rows.story: The Hurricanes won the teams’ first meeting this season, 4-1 in Seattle on Thursday. The Canes have won three straight, while the Kraken are 9-7-1. Going in, the Kraken are fourth in the Pacific (22nd in the NHL) and the Hurricanes first in the Metropolitan (tied for first).

rows.head: The Mammoth need a win
rows.story: The Mammoth are winless in four (0-2-2), and the Sharks (8-11-2) lost 3-2 in a shootout to Pittsburgh on Wednesday. Going in, the Sharks are fifth in the Pacific (tied for 23rd in the NHL) and the Mammoth fifth in the Central (tied for 14th). The Sharks’ record (.429) is about what their chances are worth.

rows.head: Open season on the Flames’ net
rows.story: The Kings are on a three-game losing streak, and the Flames (8-10-1) lost 3-1 to the Rangers on Wednesday. This is a Pacific Division matchup, with the Flames sixth (tied for 25th in the NHL) and the Kings seventh (30th). The Pacific has been the weakest of the four divisions so far.

rows.head: Strength vs. Strength
rows.story: The Stars (10-6-2) lost 8-3 to Winnipeg on Thursday, while the Panthers have won two in a row. Going in, the Cats are fifth in the Atlantic (13th in the NHL) and the Stars fourth in the Central (tied for 14th). The Panthers forecheck harder than anyone (1st), hit a lot (1st) and don't block many shots (32nd).

rows.head: Josi’s favorite opponent
rows.story: The Predators have won seven straight, and they’re rolling. The Sharks (8-11-2) lost 3-2 in a shootout to Pittsburgh on Wednesday. The Sharks won the teams’ first meeting this season, 3-2 in a shootout in Nashville on Oct 15.

rows.head: Shots will be scarce
rows.story: The Oilers won the teams’ first meeting this season, 3-2 in overtime in Edmonton on Wednesday. The Flyers are 5-10-6, while the Oilers have won three straight. Going in, the Oilers are first in the Pacific (third in the NHL) and the Flyers seventh in the Metropolitan (tied for 27th).

rows.head: Carlsson’s favorite opponent
rows.story: The Ducks have won two of the three meetings this season. The Flames (8-10-1) lost 3-1 to the Rangers on Wednesday, and the Ducks (10-8-1) lost 4-2 to Nashville the same night. This is a Pacific Division matchup, with the Flames sixth (tied for 25th in the NHL) and the Ducks third (tied for 16th).

rows.head: The Canucks are desperate for a win
rows.story: The Canucks are on a seven-game losing streak, and the Golden Knights (13-5-3) lost 3-2 in a shootout to Nashville on Friday. The Knights won the teams’ first meeting this season, 3-2 in Vancouver on Oct 4. Going in, the Canucks are last in the NHL and the Golden Knights second in the Pacific (fourth in the NHL).

rows.head: Fox’s favorite opponent
rows.story: The Rangers have won two in a row, the last a 5-1 rout of Vancouver. The Canadiens (12-3-4) beat Boston 5-2 on Thursday. Going in, the Habs are second in the Atlantic (tied for fifth in the NHL) and the Rangers third in the Metropolitan (tied for 11th).

rows.head: Something has to change for the Canucks
rows.story: The Canucks are on a seven-game losing streak, and the Mammoth are winless in four (0-2-2). The Canucks played last night, and the Mammoth are rested. Going in, the Canucks are last in the NHL and the Mammoth fifth in the Central (tied for 14th in the NHL).

standout.sub: Only 103 other games this season have matched it. Blocked shots as the home scorer recorded them.
